key_highlights: ASX suffers sharp $169B weekly wipeout amid compounding macroeconomic and consumer distress.
Australian unemployment surges to a five-year high, signaling severe labor market strain and likely halting RBA rate hikes.
Department store distress deepens as David Jones slashes 1,700 positions, accelerating retail market share shift toward Myer.
Sydney and national residential property downturn intensifies alongside rising suburban commercial vacancy rates.
Australian dollar weakens sharply against the USD as domestic recession fears escalate and terms of trade face pressure.

sectors.trend: Strong speculative interest and capital raises in gold and critical minerals contrast with macro headwinds.
sectors.implications: Favors near-term gold restarts and high-grade rare earths plays as tactical safe-haven hedges.

sectors.trend: Severe contraction in borrowing capacity, tumbling housing prices, and governance scrutiny weigh on bank earnings outlook.
sectors.implications: NIM compression and rising bad debt provisioning threaten Big Four dividend sustainability; NAB faces reputational costs.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail undergoes acute rationalisation, highlighted by mass David Jones layoffs and empty suburban tenancies.
sectors.implications: Myer gains market share and supplier leverage; overall consumer discretionary sector faces protracted multiple derating.

sectors.trend: Suburban commercial strip vacancies widen while major residential markets experience accelerated price contractions.
sectors.implications: Substantial capitalisation rate expansion and negative net asset value revisions ahead for retail and residential REITs.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas cartel power triggers price spikes, while major transition infrastructure projects face severe scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Upstream gas producers retain pricing power; regulatory intervention risk and Capex cost overruns remain elevated.

sectors.trend: Proliferation of GLP-1 weight-loss therapeutics begins altering food consumption patterns; defensive healthcare holds firm.
sectors.implications: Consumer staples face volume mix adjustments, while defensive healthcare blue chips offer portfolio resilience.

sectors.trend: AI-driven capital deployment remains robust despite broader employment and economic softness.
sectors.implications: Selective opportunity in AI enablers and data centre infrastructure, while corporate IT spending faces macro scrutiny.

key_themes: Stagflationary signals: surging unemployment alongside sticky wage and price pressures.
Monetary policy climax: five cumulative rate hikes exhaust household borrowing capacity and trigger housing market drops.
Discretionary retail shakeout driving consolidation toward low-cost and nimble operators.
Currency depreciation providing export tailwinds to offshore USD earners while amplifying import inflation.
Capital flight toward gold, critical minerals, and AI infrastructure amidst broad index liquidation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Recession Triggered by Cracking Labor Market
risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase cash weighting and rotate into defensive, low-beta dividend payers and sovereign fixed income.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Liquidity Crunch and Bank Asset Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight major domestic banks with high mortgage loan exposure; prioritize well-capitalised regional/global financials.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Severe Contraction in Consumer Discretionary Spending
risk_assessment.mitigation: Divest cyclical mall retailers and strip REITs; maintain allocation to essential staples and discount providers.
Overweight unhedged offshore earnings and USD-denominated resources leaders.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Energy Price Shock and Regulatory Intervention
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain tactical allocation to unhedged upstream domestic gas producers with domestic market exemptions.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Producers and Near-Term Developers
opportunities.rationale: Strong capital raisings, mine restart momentum, and macro volatility provide safe-haven asset support.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Myer as Market Share Consolidator
opportunities.rationale: Myer is actively capturing displaced customers and premium supplier relationships from struggling David Jones.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Rare Earths and Critical Mineral Breakthroughs
opportunities.rationale: High-recovery metallurgical advances and US supply chain alignment offer strong idiosyncratic growth.
Depreciating AUD enhances translational earnings for high-quality multinational market leaders.

defensive_moves.rationale: $169B weekly index wipeout and surging unemployment warrant defensive hedging via inverse ETFs or index put options.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Major Mortgage Lenders and Bank Retail Book
defensive_moves.rationale: Collapsing borrowing power and accelerating home price drops pose substantial credit quality risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Retail Commercial Property REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging suburban strip vacancies and tenant failures threaten distribution yields and property valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into Resilient Consumer Staples and Utilities
defensive_moves.rationale: Inelastic consumer demand and regulated utility cash flows buffer portfolios against stagflationary pressures.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months; expect elevated volatility on the ASX 200 as surging unemployment and consumer distress trigger earnings downgrades.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral over 6–12 months; market bottoming expected as the RBA reaches peak policy restrictiveness and pivots toward rate cuts.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decisions and policy statements in response to deteriorating labor conditions
Australian Bureau of Statistics labor force data (unemployment rate and employment change)
Quarterly Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Wage Price Index releases
CoreLogic residential dwelling values and auction clearance rates across Sydney and Melbourne
David Jones creditor administration developments and wider retail tenancy solvency

Australian 3-year and 10-year Commonwealth Government Bond yields
Iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) spot price movements
Major Australian bank residential non-performing loan (NPL) ratios
